# Documentation Update Skill

**Purpose:** Identify and update documentation after code or configuration changes to keep docs synchronized.

**When to use:**
- After any firmware code or constant change
- When API endpoints are added or modified
- After updating settings or hardware configuration
- When workflow or testing procedures change

## Quick Decision Guide

Use this table to find which docs to update based on what changed:

| Change | Update These Files |
|---|---|
| GPIO pins, pulse timing | `docs/WIRING_README.md` |
| API endpoint or response schema | `docs/API_REFERENCE.md`, `docs/TEST_README.md`, `skills/api-validation/validate_api.py` |
| WiFi strategy logic | `AGENTS.md`, `skills/log-analysis/.instructions.md`, `skills/strategy-comparison/.instructions.md` |
| Upload toolchain, FQBN flags | `docs/ESP32_UPLOAD_README.md`, `skills/firmware-upload/.instructions.md` |
| New firmware module structure | `AGENTS.md`, `firmware/esp32_inverter_bridge/` module headers |
| Log format (`[WIFI-CONNECT]` entries) | `skills/log-analysis/.instructions.md`, `skills/strategy-comparison/.instructions.md` |
| Test procedures | `docs/TEST_README.md` |
| Hardware pins, adapters | `docs/SETUP_README.md`, `docs/WIRING_README.md`, `README.md`, `AGENTS.md` |
| Build constants (`settings.cpp`) | `docs/SETUP_README.md`, relevant skill docs |

## Reference Resources

Each documentation file has a resource guide in `skills/documentation-update/resources/`:

| File | Resource |
|---|---|
| `docs/SETUP_README.md` | `setup.md` |
| `docs/WIRING_README.md` | `wiring.md` |
| `docs/ESP32_UPLOAD_README.md` | `upload.md` |
| `docs/TEST_README.md` | `test-readme.md` |
| `docs/API_REFERENCE.md` | `api-reference.md` |
| `README.md` | `readme.md` |
| `AGENTS.md` | `agents.md` |

## Key Principle

**Each fact belongs in exactly one canonical location.** Other files should link to it instead of repeating it.

## Process

1. Identify what changed in the code
2. Use the decision guide above to find affected docs
3. Read the resource file for that documentation
4. Update only the necessary sections
5. Cross-check that links point to the right places
6. Run `skills/api-validation/validate_api.py` if any API changes

## Common Scenarios

**Timeout value changed:**
- Edit `docs/SETUP_README.md` configuration section
- Update `AGENTS.md` performance table if it was performance-critical

**New WiFi constant added:**
- Update `settings.cpp` comment
- No docs update needed unless it's user-configurable

**Recovery threshold changed (e.g., 5 → 8 failures):**
- Update `AGENTS.md` module summary
- Update relevant TODO or incident documents
- No user-facing docs change needed (internal mechanism)

**New API endpoint:**
- Add to `docs/API_REFERENCE.md`
- Add to `docs/TEST_README.md` test cases
- Update `skills/api-validation/validate_api.py` validation logic
